description:
Use this when the user or an astrologer asks for a specific classical computation — planetary strength, transit point tables, another life-period timeline, the annual chart, house cusps, a named yoga, the birth pañcāṅga, Manglik, house lords and aspects — rather than for a reading. Pass `sections` to fetch only what is needed.
The computed classical working for a chart, no model: strength scores for each planet and house, point tables for transit support, further life-period timelines with the periods running at `referenceDate`, the full planetary-period ladder, the annual chart for the year running at `referenceDate`, house-cusp and ruling-planet tables, classical yogas, special ascendants and aspects, the natal pañcāṅga, house lords with planetary aspects, Manglik (Kuja doṣa) with its exceptions, and what would change under another ayanāṁśa. Each section is `{computed: true, data}` or `{computed: false, reason}` — a technique that cannot be computed for this chart (for example without a birth time) says why and the rest still return. No verdicts, scores or lifespan figures.
Cost: 3 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"sections":["shadbala","dashas","panchanga"],"referenceDate":"2026-10-14T00:00:00Z"}

birthData.description: The person's birth data: date, local time (omit if unknown), IANA timezone, latitude and longitude.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

referenceDate.description: ISO date or datetime for the running periods and the annual chart's year. Defaults to now.

residence.description: Where the person lives; the annual chart is cast for this place. Defaults to the birthplace.

sections.description: Return only these sections. Default: all.

name: get_techniques

techniques.description: One entry per requested section. `dashas` holds the further life-period timelines, each a section.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Classical techniques for a chart
